Dogecoin Surges 156% Post-Election

$DOGE jumped 156%, reaching $0.30, flipping XRP in market cap.
📈 Elon #Musk  hints and #Trump 's win fueled the rally. Analysts predict a parabolic rise, with potential targets of $3.95 to $23.26 based on historical patterns. https://t.co/nrZJJEU3WD

For $SHIB to truly rally, two things need to happen: 
1️⃣ A major narrative shift—like #Dogecoin had with Elon’s tweets. 
2️⃣ More utility— #Shibarium adoption, new use cases, or a broader #DeFi push.
Until then, burns alone won’t send SHIB to $0.0001. https://t.co/7kLFrn7CsM
